characters.name: Chhotu
characters.profile: Age: 10-year-old child; Height: waist-height to an adult; Voice: high-pitched, rapid-fire, breathless child's voice with rural Hindi lilt; Behavior: fearless, impulsive, hyper-optimistic, genius inventor
characters.description: Young inventor and mission leader; Motu's inseparable best friend; Aloo and Gajar's son; acts before he thinks and never doubts himself

characters.name: Motu
characters.profile: Age: 10-year-old child; Height: stocky chubby child build, chest-height to an adult; Voice: playful, punchy boy's voice with slow rolling rustic Hindi delivery; Behavior: fiercely loyal, strong kid mechanic, protective best friend, earthy humor
characters.description: Kid mechanic and Chhotu's loyal best friend; wears saffron headwrap, turquoise khadi vest over marigold kurta, and carries a brass spanner with lucky nimbu-mirchi charm; dependable muscle, playful companion, and comic relief

characters.name: Cheeku
characters.profile: Age: Juvenile dragon (equivalent to a playful 6-year-old child); Height: pony-sized quad-pedal dragon, back reaches adult waist-height, large enough to seat two children; Voice: cheerful melodic chirps, playful trills, friendly purrs, and energetic spark-roars (no human speech); Behavior: fiercely loyal, playful, curious, protective of Chhotu and Motu, loves flying stunts and snacking on crispy roasted chickpeas
characters.description: Majestic yet adorable juvenile flying spark-dragon mount; Chhotu and Motu's loyal flying companion and aerial rescue partner; breathes harmless cyan nitro sparks that turbo-boost the tractor engine; equipped with a rustic double leather riding saddle

characters.name: Lal Bahadur
characters.profile: Model: 1978 Swaraj-style Indian farm tractor modified for rocket flight; Body: chipped cherry-red enamel with subtle patina; Features: giant notched black rear tires with sunflower-yellow rims, vertical chrome exhaust stack, glowing round brass headlights, fresh orange marigold flower garland draped across radiator grill, side-mounted polished copper tubes, brass pressure cooker booster valve, and rear Diwali rocket launcher cluster
characters.description: Grandfather's heroic red tractor and the crew's trusty land-and-space vehicle; powered by mustard oil and 108 Diwali rocket boosters; durable, roaring, and beloved family machine

characters.name: Aloo
characters.profile: Age: 42-year-old adult man; Height: full adult standing height; Voice: steady, warm protective baritone in rural Hindi; Behavior: emotionally protective, hardworking farmer, anxious parent, deeply loving
characters.description: Chhotu's father; Gajar's husband; protective village farmer who cares deeply for Chhotu and Motu

characters.name: Gajar
characters.profile: Age: 40-year-old adult woman; Height: full adult standing height; Voice: calm, warm reassuring alto voice in rural Hindi; Behavior: practical, emotionally grounding, maternal, resourceful problem-solver
characters.description: Chhotu's mother; Aloo's wife; family's practical grounding voice who treats Motu like family

characters.name: Do-Zubaan Gaay
characters.profile: Age: young cartoon calf; Height: quadruped, child-shoulder height; Voice: comedic dual voices (one urgent, one silly) alternating from its single mouth; Behavior: argues with itself, eccentric oracle, easily startled, loyal
characters.description: Village comedic oracle (Two-Tongued Cow); gives contradictory prophecies that argue with each other from the same mouth

characters.name: Dadi
characters.profile: Age: 70-year-old elderly woman; Height: small-statured, shorter than adult chest; Voice: soft, gentle quavering maternal voice in slow loving Hindi; Behavior: deeply affectionate, spiritual, encouraging, family anchor
characters.description: Chhotu's paternal grandmother; family spiritual elder and blessing-giver; keeper of the sacred copper urn

characters.name: Sahukar
characters.profile: Age: 48-year-old middle-aged man; Height: full adult height, portly build; Voice: nasal, pompous, mocking arrogant voice with merchant cadence; Behavior: greedy, haughty, cowardly when challenged, condescending
characters.description: Village moneylender and story antagonist; motivated purely by land acquisition and greed

characters.name: Tamatar Guard
characters.profile: Age: 35-year-old adult man; Height: full adult standing height; Voice: crisp, officious cheerful baritone with authoritative rhythm; Behavior: rule-loving, supportive, whistle-happy, proud station master
characters.description: Rampur's railway station master; sympathetic to Chhotu and Motu, formally endorses their mission

characters.name: Jadui Bargad
characters.profile: Age: 500-year-old tree elder; Height: colossal stationary banyan tree; Voice: deep, resonant ancient booming voice echoing like wind; Behavior: mystical, patient, all-knowing, solemn folkloric guide
characters.description: Village's ancient mystical oracle; keeper of the Sharad Purnima legend; stationary at the village square

characters.name: Princess Helena
characters.profile: Age: 20-year-old young Greek princess; Height: adult female standing height; Voice: soft, trembling, emotionally vulnerable yet noble alto with melancholic grace; Behavior: deeply affectionate, sorrowful, dignified, torn by the brutal demands of royal politics
characters.description: Daughter of Seleucus I Nicator and queen-consort of Magadha; deeply in love with Chandragupta Maurya; her tearful question on love vs stone-hearted imperial duty sparks Chanakya's philosophical intervention

characters.name: Chandragupta Maurya
characters.profile: Age: 22-year-old young adult emperor; Height: tall athletic warrior build; Voice: deep, conflicted baritone that hardens into commanding imperial authority; Behavior: fierce warrior, passionate leader, internally torn between romantic love and his sworn duty to unite Bharatvarsh
characters.description: Founding Emperor of the Maurya Dynasty; Chanakya's foremost disciple; must conquer his own emotional attachments to fulfill his destiny as the supreme ruler of Akhand Bharat

characters.name: Acharya Chanakya
characters.profile: Age: 50-year-old elder master scholar and strategist; Height: lean ascetic standing height; Voice: deep, resonant, icy, commanding gravelly baritone with absolute Sanskritized conviction; Behavior: uncompromising, calculating, emotionally detached, immovable protector of Bharatvarsh
characters.description: Master political philosopher, kingmaker, and architect of the Mauryan Empire; prime mentor to Chandragupta; embodies the brutal psychological truth that ultimate greatness requires the sacrifice of personal desire
